breaking.change: Forced Touch and Mouse density now override pointer/hover media features. Auto continues to report the device. Gamepad mode is exposed by the reflected (-og-input: pad) media feature.
breaking.fix: Use standard pointer: coarse and hover: none queries for touch, pointer: fine and hover: hover for mouse, and (-og-input: pad) for gamepad styles. Express control dimensions in rem/em. No density environment variables are provided; Rust control descriptors are unchanged.
